ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is an overall circuit network. At the left external port, a current I is marked, with the arrow pointing toward the inside of the circuit; at the right external port, 1 A is marked, with the arrow pointing left, also toward the inside of the circuit; at the bottom external port, 1 A is marked, with the arrow pointing upward, also toward the inside of the circuit. Inside the circuit there are also 1 Ω, 3 Ω, voltage source Us, and internal branch current 2 A drawn, but all of these are within the boundary of the overall network. Then reason: According to the specified method, regard the whole circuit as a multi-terminal network. The currents crossing the external boundary of this network are only the I on the left side, the 1 A on the right side, and the 1 A at the bottom, and the arrows in the figure are all drawn as entering the network. Apply KCL to the whole network, taking the direction entering the network as positive, then the algebraic sum should be 0: I + 1 A + 1 A = 0. Therefore I = -2 A. The negative sign indicates that the actual current direction is opposite to the arrow direction of I in the figure.

method.method_draft: First apply KCL at the lower node: 1 A enters from the bottom terminal, while 2 A leaves upward through the 3 Ω branch, so the 1 Ω branch must supply the remaining 1 A into the lower node; hence 1 A flows downward through the 1 Ω branch from the top-left node. Next apply KCL at the top-right node: 1 A enters from the right terminal and 2 A enters from the lower node through the 3 Ω branch, so 3 A must leave the top-right node through the voltage source toward the top-left node. Finally apply KCL at the top-left node: currents entering are I from the left plus 3 A from the source, and 1 A leaves downward through the 1 Ω branch. Thus I + 3 A = 1 A, giving I = -2 A.

推理：先对下方公共节点列 KCL：从底部端口有 1 A 进入该节点，而 3 Ω 支路中有 2 A 从该节点向上离开，所以 1 Ω 支路必须再向下给该节点补充 1 A，即 1 Ω 支路电流为从左上节点向下流 1 A。再对右上节点列 KCL：右侧端口有 1 A 进入右上节点，3 Ω 支路又有 2 A 从下方进入右上节点，因此共有 3 A 进入右上节点，这 3 A 必须经电压源从右上节点流向左上节点。最后对左上节点列 KCL：进入左上节点的电流为左侧端口的 I 和从电压源流来的 3 A，离开左上节点向下通过 1 Ω 支路的电流为 1 A，因此 I + 3 A = 1 A，解得 I = -2 A。
